scope: Exactly three source complexity roots. Generated artifacts, suppressions, dependencies and unrelated concurrent edits unchanged.

rootCauses.name: Player presentation complexity
rootCauses.evidence: Cyclomatic complexity 18 and cognitive complexity 17; presentation defaults obscured playback and viewport ownership.
rootCauses.impact: Maintenance improvement, not a confirmed visible bug or measured performance improvement.
rootCauses.fix: Extract pure presentation props for dimensions, poster, audio volume and inline styles. Keep playback state, hover handlers, viewport subscription and source selection in the parent.
rootCauses.tests: Three tests pass before and after: lazy gating/bypass, source helper gating, default/custom sizes, ratios, poster/audio, hover toggling, mount-owned playback state and mounted player identity.

rootCauses.name: Section container-layout complexity
rootCauses.evidence: Cyclomatic complexity 17 and cognitive complexity 18; width/padding/full-height configuration was mixed with background rendering.
rootCauses.impact: Maintenance improvement with no intended visual or interaction change.
rootCauses.fix: Extract pure container layout calculation; retain theme/background hook ownership, style precedence, element order and identifiers.
rootCauses.tests: Six tests pass before and after: absent/one/two/four-part padding, full-height mode, theme and explicit widths, none width, overflow, identifiers, background order, child order and variant precedence.

rootCauses.name: Snackbar presentation complexity
rootCauses.evidence: Cyclomatic complexity 23 and cognitive complexity 31; dialog/toast branches and styling obscured timer, cookie and visibility ownership.
rootCauses.impact: Maintenance improvement; no intended dismissal, timing, hydration or appearance changes.
rootCauses.fix: Extract module-scope dialog and toast components plus toast style calculation. Keep visibility state, cookie handling, timers, cleanup and acceptance handler in the parent.
rootCauses.tests: Six existing lifecycle tests plus three new presentation tests pass before and after: hydration DOM identity, SSR, show/hide-on-scroll, timers and cleanup, cookie writes, dialog dismissal policy, action order/colors, toast style/anchors and editor preview.
